items.title: 8.4 Reflection ke method (tareeqe) se polarized light (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.4 with Fig. 8.6 and Example 8.1 (PDF 177-178).

blocks.text: 1808 mein Malus ne maloom kiya ke jab aam light glass (sheeshe) ki plane (seedhi) sheet se reflect ho (surface (satah) se takra kar wapas aaye) to polarized light milti hai. Agar reflect hone wali light ko polaroid se dekhein aur polaroid ko line of vision (nazar ki lakeer) ke gird aahista ghumayein, to polaroid ki ek position par light taqreeban extinguish ho (bujh) jati hai. Sheeshe ke liye sab se suitable (munasib) angle of incidence ‘i’ taqreeban 57° hai, jis par reflect hone wali ray plane polarized ho jati hai (ray diagram, Fig. 8.6). Is se sabit hota hai ke sheeshe se reflect hone wali light taqreeban plane polarized hai. Mez ki surface se reflect hone wali light ghumai hui polaroid se dekhne par dark (madhham) hoti hai, yani woh partially (kuch had tak) plane polarized hai.

blocks.alt: Ray diagram. Har direction (simt) mein vibrations wali unpolarized light Medium 1 (n1, hawa) aur Medium 2 (n2, crown glass, n = 1.52; n2 > n1) ki sarhad par dashed normal se i = theta_p = 57 degrees par parti hai. Mun'akis plane polarized light ki vibrations nuqton (dots) se dikhai gayi hain aur use polaroid se dekha jata hai. r = theta_r par refracted light par dohre teer hain. Mun'akis aur refracted shuaon mein 90 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.6: Reflection se plane polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Crown glass (n = 1.52) ke liye tan θₚ = 1.52, yani θₚ taqreeban 57°. Is angle par reflect hone wali aur refract hone wali rays ek doosre se 90° par hoti hain. Reflect hone wali light ki vibration sirf plane of incidence ke perpendicular (kaghaz ke andar-bahar) hoti hai, is liye usay dots se dikhaya gaya hai. Refract hone wali light partially polarized hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.6 reflect hone wali plane polarized light par har direction ke teer, aur polaroid ke baad kaghaz ke plane mein ek dohra teer dikhati hai. Sahi yeh hai ke polarizing angle par reflect hone wali light ki vibration sirf plane of incidence ke perpendicular hoti hai; isi liye hamari figure mein dots hain.
